{{Quote|A battle is coming, my brothers, a battle between the Sith and that which they fear the most&mdash;us.|Darth Maul, to his Shadow Collective allies|<ref name="Son of Dathomir 2" />}}
The '''Battle on Ord Mantell''' was fought between the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on and in orbit of the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The battle was devised by Maul and [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], who suspected that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and Separatists were trying to draw Talzin out into the open to destroy her. The battle was designed to capture [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] by luring them into a trap on Ord Mantell.

Maul planned the trap along with his Shadow Collective allies, including [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], and the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]]. Directly before the arrival of the Separatist forces, a group of [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] lead by [[Viscus/Legends|Viscus]] arrived in a transport, which had been sent by Talzin as reinforcements. When the battle began, the Shadow Collective forces engaged the [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]] on the surface, while Maul made his way into orbit and boarded Grievous' command ship Grievous disabled the battle droid army after Maul gave him the choice to do so or die, and the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general was taken into custody. Dooku, meanwhile, had engaged and defeated the Nightbrothers in battle, before being captured by Shadow Collective forces.

With the battle over, Maul contacted Talzin, who told him they would soon capture [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and have their revenge against the Sith.
